pages.text: Craft a building infection core with living hive tissue and three rotten flesh. Place it against a supported outer wall. Use an empty hand to inspect growth. Feed the core or leave edible drops where its mouth can reach them. Keep the area loaded.

A mature colony produces infected according to stage and stored nutrients. Several mouths can belong to one hive. An empty reserve, blocked exit or full local population can stall production. For a city portal, plant unprocessed tissue as described in $(l:gateway)Grow a Passage$(/l).
